import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

path=Path('results/training/qwen38_test_finish.json')
assert not path.exists(), 'Only one rerun authorized; inspect any existing receipt'
plan_path=Path('results/training/qwen38_test_finish_plan.json'); plan=json.loads(plan_path.read_text())
assert file_sha256(plan['selection_file'])==plan['selection_sha256']
folder=Path('runs/kaggle_qwen38_test_finish'); meta=json.loads((folder/'kernel-metadata.json').read_text())
assert meta==plan['metadata'] and meta['is_private'] and meta['enable_gpu'] and meta['enable_internet']
assert file_sha256(folder/meta['code_file'])==plan['source_sha256']
env={**os.environ,'KAGGLE_CONFIG_DIR':str(Path('runs/kaggle_oauth_config').resolve())}
for name in ('KAGGLE_KEY','KAGGLE_API_TOKEN','KAGGLE_TOKEN_FILE'): env.pop(name,None)
subprocess.run(['/Users/nico/.local/share/uv/tools/kaggle/bin/python','scripts/kaggle_quota.py'],env=env,check=True)
snapshot=json.loads(Path('results/training/kaggle_account_budget_snapshot.json').read_text()); q=snapshot['quota']
assert q['gpu_seconds_total']-q['gpu_seconds_used']-q['gpu_seconds_reserved']>=plan['session_timeout_seconds']
command=['kaggle','kernels','push','-p',str(folder),'--accelerator','NvidiaTeslaT4','--timeout',str(plan['session_timeout_seconds'])]
record={'provenance':receipt({'purpose':'ONE missing-only frozen-policy test continuation'},plan['provenance']['model_revision']),
 'source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'plan_sha256':file_sha256(plan_path),'selection_sha256':plan['selection_sha256'],
 'metadata':meta,'source_sha256':plan['source_sha256'],'quota_snapshot':snapshot,'session_timeout_seconds':plan['session_timeout_seconds'],
 'status':'submitting','submitted_at':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'polls':[]}
path.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
r=subprocess.run(command,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True)
record['push']={'command':command,'exit_code':r.returncode,'output':r.stdout,'error':r.stderr}
version=re.search(r'Kernel version (\d+)',r.stdout); actual=re.search(r'https://www.kaggle.com/code/([^/\s]+/[^/\s]+)',r.stdout)
if actual: meta['id']=actual[1]
record.update(status='submitted' if r.returncode==0 and version else 'push_requires_inspection',version=int(version[1]) if version else None)
path.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
assert record['status']=='submitted','Inspect ambiguous submission; do not submit a second rerun'
p=Path('results/training/kaggle_budget.json'); ledger=json.loads(p.read_text())
ledger['sessions'].append({'kernel':meta['id'],'version':record['version'],'accelerator':'T4 x2 requested',
 'start':None,'end':None,'hours':None,'submitted_at':record['submitted_at'],'private':True,'status':'submitted',
 'source_commit':record['provenance']['git_commit'],'receipt':str(path),'session_timeout_seconds':plan['session_timeout_seconds'],
 'purpose':'ONE missing-only continuation: same selected 27B adapter, final 8 cards test episodes.',
 'hours_basis':'Pending downloaded wrapper runtime; cap is not measured GPU usage.'})
p.write_text(json.dumps(ledger,indent=2)+'\n')
verify=Path('runs/verify_qwen38_test_finish'); verify.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
cmd=['kaggle','kernels','pull',meta['id'],'-p',str(verify),'-m']
r=subprocess.run(cmd,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True)
assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
saved_meta=json.loads((verify/'kernel-metadata.json').read_text())
assert saved_meta['is_private']
assert file_sha256(verify/meta['code_file'])==plan['source_sha256']
record['saved_source_verification']={'command':cmd,'private':True,'matches_submitted_source':True,'source_sha256':plan['source_sha256']}
path.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Submitted and verified private saved rerun',meta['id'],record['version'],flush=True)
subprocess.run(['.venv/bin/python','-u','scripts/watch_kaggle.py','--receipt',str(path),'--out',f"results/kaggle/qwen38-test-finish-v{record['version']}"],check=True)
